compute_bootstrapped_std_error: compute the bootstrapped standard error of mean for a numpy array or torch tensor
create_cpe_estimate: create a CpeEstimate named tuple with raw and normalized counterfactual policy evaluation values and standard errors
create_cpe_estimate_set: create a CpeEstimateSet named tuple holding multiple counterfactual policy evaluation estimates including direct method and doubly robust
log_cpe_details: log reward and metric counterfactual policy evaluation estimates to the logger via CpeDetails
log_cpe_to_tensorboard: log counterfactual policy evaluation estimates to TensorBoard using CpeEstimateSet or CpeDetails
